inventedClaims.what: The narrator skips work and Rhindquist comforts him with comedies and explains why he selected him; this is unrelated to Lawrence answering a phone with his lifelogger disabled.
The narrator drives recklessly with Rhindquist and accepts his new role after a coworker's mocking message; the passage instead shows Lawrence introducing himself at dinner.
A guild dissolves and imposes rules on its former members; the passage concerns Laurie's fear of Google's surveillance.
Ria explains Buhle's rise and shows Leon genetically engineered bears in Central Park; the passage instead presents an argument about democratic control and manipulation of the network.
Lawrence leaves the Order after sixteen cloistered years; the passage concerns Tony bringing documents to a narrator who enjoys overseeing company information.
Trish learns that a rescued surfer died and Rainer comforts her; the passage instead reveals Buhle's concealed ownership of jetpack manufacturing.
Rainer and Trish negotiate over a compromise bill during a second outage; the passage describes Leon's temporary relief from anxiety during a helicopter flight.
The section is an author's note about Bruce Sterling's workshop and meeting Raph Koster; the passage instead concerns leverage over the Institute's planned shutdown and backup of BIGMAC.
